description: Calendar view is now live. Household view with combined pay and bills. Personal view for your split (if in household)/personal bills.
Bills & Debts now automatically sort to due soonest. (You can change how it's sorted with drop down)
Fixed sorting in bills due on dashboard. Now sorts by owed soonest. Bills and debts were sorted by numerical value instead of actual date — fixed.
When you mark a bill as paid in Total Bills, it will now update the dashboard.
Mobile login was broken — has been fixed.
Credit score renamed to Credit Cards; fixed recommendations display.
